evidence_note: Assessed 2026-10-24. Not ingest-ready. NBS terms state: You are allowed to download and use the statistical data on this website. They also state: When reprinting or quoting the content of this website, it must be a reasonable and good faith quoting for the purpose of use of news or free public information. Clause II.5.d says the following shall not be carried out: Allow others to continue to reprint and quote the content of this website without authorization. Security clause IV.2 prohibits illegally detecting, scanning and testing the system. No documented unauthenticated machine-readable API was identified. The March 2026 data-portal notice describes a website at data.stats.gov.cn during a trial period, not an open licence for commercial publication. An earlier NBS reply told users to register and download. No account was created. Undocumented query endpoints were not called. No file was imported, because commercial publication is not clearly permitted. A cumulative year-to-date growth rate is not stored as an ordinary monthly observation. This row is the industrial production. The series was not bound.
